narrative.details:
Ye're brave... <cough>... to come into Uldaman fer me, champion.

If ye're really here to help... ol' Hammertoe, then... <cough>... you'll need to find... me amulet.

Deepshadow's got it... Magregan Deepshadow. He's 'round here... in the ruins fer sure. That amulet'll lead 'em... <cough>...  right to the scrolls if he ain't stopped. It's up to you, adventurer. Please... get that amulet.

The scrolls will surely help the Dark Irons create even more powerful golems. I just know it. I can feel it in me bones.
narrative.objectives: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ha! <cough cough>

Ah knew you'd find me amulet, adventurer.

<weeze> Well done indeed, adventurer. <cough>
narrative.requestItemsText: The Shadowforge clan... <cough> is dangerous. Be careful. <cough> You must find the amulet.
